personal-context.heading: Personal context
personal-context.heading-tooltip: Includes the teacher's personal context profile in chats with this assistant.
personal-context.description: Personal context is switched off for assistants by default.

personal-context.heading: Personal context
personal-context.description: Information that AIS.chat takes into account about you in chats. AIS.chat adds to this text automatically based on your conversations. You can edit or delete it at any time.
personal-context.toggle-description: When switched off, the text is neither included in chats nor extended automatically.
personal-context.auto-update-toggle-description: When switched off, AIS.chat stops adding to the text automatically from your conversations. The existing text stays available in chats, but you can only edit it yourself from then on.
personal-context.editor-description: The text is Markdown. Entries are kept as bullet points under headings.
personal-context.editor-placeholder:
## About me
- Teaches mathematics in lower secondary education

chat-toggle.enable: Use personal context in this chat
chat-toggle.disable: Do not use personal context in this chat
chat-toggle.error: The setting could not be changed
